description: Only when the user asks to follow, unfollow or list Edge collections (for example "follow collection federico/comms", "follow this collection" with a getedge.cc/collections/ link, "show my collections"): a collection is a creator's set of skills for one outcome. Following pins its current revision; find_skill then ranks its skills first whenever they fit a task, right after the user's starred skills. Pass collection_id as the name, id or link the user gave. Never call it on your own initiative. Reply with the returned line.

action.description: follow, unfollow, or list the user's followed collections

collection_id.description: The collection's name (federico/comms), id or getedge.cc/collections/ link; required to follow or unfollow

name: manage_collection
title: Edge Skills: follow a collection
